archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) - adapted for Premium Corporate / Academic Dashboard
design_philosophy: A modern, professional workforce management system balancing the seriousness of enterprise software with warm, inviting aesthetics. Moving away from harsh 'blood reds' and clinical whites, the design embraces refined burgundy/wine reds, warm cream surfaces, and soft blush pinks. The result is a 'Premium Academic/Enterprise' feel—trustworthy, highly legible, and beautifully tactile.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary-hover rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 transition-colors font-medium shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary-hover rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 transition-colors font-medium
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-text-primary hover:bg-primary-light rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors font-medium

components.cards: bg-card border border-border rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
components.inputs: bg-white border border-border rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary text-text-primary placeholder-text-muted transition-all

tables.header: bg-table_header border-b border-border text-left text-xs font-semibold text-primary uppercase tracking-wider py-4 px-6

sidebar_link.default: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-text-secondary hover:bg-white hover:text-primary transition-all group font-medium
sidebar_link.active: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg bg-white text-primary shadow-sm font-semibold

pages.name: Welcome / Login Landing
pages.layout: Split screen (50/50). Left side: full-height abstract modern image with an overlay, brand name 'DAILY TRACKER' in large Playfair Display. Right side: Login/Signup form centered in a warm cream container.
key_elements: Input fields for Agent ID / Password
Subtle floating micro-animations on the form container

pages.name: Dashboard Shell (Layout)
pages.layout: Left sidebar (soft blush pink) + Top Header (white) + Main Content (warm cream).
key_elements: Sidebar: Brand logo/title top, Navigation links (Calendar, Staffs, Holidays, Leaves, Reports, History), Logout bottom.
Header: Hamburger menu (mobile), Page Title, Notification Bell, User Avatar.

pages.name: Calendar Module
pages.layout: Full-width card containing the calendar grid.
key_elements: Header controls: Prev/Next month, Today button, View toggle (Monthly/Yearly).
Grid: 7 columns (Sun-Sat), proper empty cells for offset days.
Cells: Display date number, badges/dots for attendance status or shifts.
Hover effect on cells for interaction.

pages.name: Staffs Module
pages.layout: Header with 'Add Staff' button + Data Table.
key_elements: Table columns: Agent ID, Display Name, Fullname, Position, Shift, Contact Number, Actions

pages.name: Holidays Module
key_elements: Table columns: Date, Region, Occasion, Details, Actions.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and links must have subtle background color transitions (e.g., duration-200). Table rows highlight on hover.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade-in for main content area when switching sidebar routes.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Sidebar icons slightly translate-x-1 on hover. Active sidebar link gets a soft drop shadow.

welcome_hero_bg.description: Abstract modern architecture with warm wooden boards to be used as background image on the left side of the login split screen.

welcome_hero_bg_alt.description: Burgundy abstract texture that can be used as an alternative or overlaid texture for hero branding.

dashboard_avatar.description: Placeholder for professional business avatars if needed.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette to ensure the app doesn't look like generic SaaS. The contrast between the warm cream background and the wine/burgundy primary elements is crucial.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactive elements (Select, Dialog, Tabs) but style them to remove the default 'Vercel-look'. Override border radius and colors as defined.
The login page must use a split-screen design. Ensure the left side image is prominent and features the 'DAILY TRACKER' text overlaid.
Use 'Playfair Display' for the 'DAILY TRACKER' logo and major hero text, and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for the dashboard UI text.
Ensure the sidebar uses the soft blush pink (#FDF5F6) and the table headers use the same to create a unified theme.
Implement the full calendar grid (7x5 or 7x6) correctly with days offset based on the month.
